Improve this selected implementation design while preserving the user's outcome and constraints. Trace it as a coding agent would. Identify concrete corrections to ownership, interfaces, sequencing, compatibility, error/recovery, observability, or verification. Prefer a smaller coherent correction. Propose another architecture only if evidence shows this one cannot satisfy a hard constraint. Do not implement, use tools, delegate, invoke skills, or edit files. All evidence is in this packet; identify gaps instead of inventing facts. Map every explicit requirement to a plan location and acceptance criterion; flag missing coverage. Then return findings with priority (blocking/improvement), plan location, supporting source evidence or evidence gap, implementing-agent failure mode, and proposed correction. Omit style-only preferences. If no material findings exist, say `No material findings` after the coverage map. Additional verified facts (not in the brief): - `PermissionState` (apps/desktop/src/application/application-controller.ts:41-44): `{kind:'fresh'; listing}` | `{kind:'loading'|'stale'; listing: AvailablePermissions|null; reason}` | `{kind:'unsupported'; reason}`. Initial value (line 148): `{kind:'stale', listing:null, reason:'Open a conversation to read permissions.'}`. - `ProviderObservationStatus` (packages/contracts/src/observation.ts:19-22): `not-applicable|recovering|observing` | `stopped` | `concluded`; controller adds `{kind:'unknown'}`. - `CommandActivity`/`FileActivity` return null when empty. - Tests: journey.browser.test.mjs:238 waits for heading 'Your conversation'; module-actions.browser.test.mjs:27 finds `complementary 'Customization fixture'`, :43/:73 read textbox 'Message' value, :85 reads `.scope-label` textContent; agent-routing.test.mjs:146-147 assert chips ['Codex','Select model','Default'] and the disabled effort button; tests/host/extensions/extension-only.test.mjs:152,159 assert body text lacks /Recorded playback|Recorded host/. - agent-presentation.ts: codex footer 'Local Codex · Approvals required for changes', buildLabel 'Local Codex host'; recorded footer 'Recorded playback · No live model', buildLabel 'Browser development · Recorded host'. - BrowserApplication.tsx keeps `app.active` while `selectedView` is 'extensions'; the chat view is hidden via `hidden` on `.shell-view`, not unmounted. ## Selected design rationale (summary) Base design: "show only what can act" — gate chrome on relevance, move non-empty custom tool modules to the Extensions view, "+" and panel-wide drop for images. Grafted: visually-hidden header (tests/a11y), kind-based permission gate, auto-grow textarea, disclosure moved to shell footer, panel-wide drop target, Extensions tools section names its conversation. Rejected: composer Tools popover (keeps tools on this screen), combined harness/model picker and details drawer (scope), byte sniffing (host is authority), greeting line (calmer without). ## Plan files ### 00-overview.md # Simplify the new-conversation screen Status: Ready (pending refinement pass). Implementation has not started. Base commit: `10a4d08` on `main`. ## Application context The context was confirmed for this repository on 2026-11-18 in `.agents/plans/extensions-nav-crew-coworkers/00-overview.md` and is reused here. OpenPane has one user, on a private overlay network. ```json { "application_context": { "has_active_users": false, "backward_compatibility_required": false, "feature_flags": "not-applicable", "confirmation_digest": "34b9a519ecefc94d75efe4ffa2fc7671cf5c90bb1936dde430a6049a2beb93b4", "confirmed_at": "2026-11-18T04:10:00Z" } } ``` The change is a direct UI cutover. It needs no flag and no compatibility shim. ## Change type and affected areas This is a UI redesign of the desktop conversation panel. It touches these files: - `apps/desktop/src/application/ConversationView.tsx` - `ConversationPermissions.tsx` - `CustomizationModules.tsx` - `CustomizationContent.tsx` - `ComposerAgentControls.tsx` - `ExtensionsView.tsx` - `application.css` - `apps/desktop/src/shell/BrowserApplication.tsx` - `apps/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json` - the browser tests under `tests/application/` ## Requested outcome An empty conversation shows a calm canvas with one composer, and it still looks like OpenPane. Success criteria. Each is observable in the browser build: 1. An empty Codex conversation shows only the composer: the placeholder, "+", the harness chip, the model chip and Send. The page also shows the shell footer. It does not show a visible header, a Permissions card, "Send a message to begin.", "Custom tools", the disabled effort chip or the in-composer disclosure line. 2. Typing in the composer shows only the caret. The computed `box-shadow` of `.composer` is `none` while the textarea has focus. 3. The textarea has no resize grip (`resize: none`). It grows with its content up to a cap, then scrolls. 4. Dropping a PNG or JPEG anywhere on the conversation panel attaches it. Invalid drops explain why and change nothing. 5. Custom tool modules no longer render on the conversation screen. Non-empty modules appear in the Extensions view. Empty module sets render nothing anywhere. 6. The icon rail and the Chats sidebar are unchanged, in both markup and CSS. ## Scope and non-goals In scope: - the conversation panel and its composer; - the components the panel renders; - the effort chip in the empty-workspace screen, which shares `ComposerAgentControls`; - the shell footer's right-hand label while the Chats view is shown. Not in scope: - `.view-rail`, `.application-controls` and the Chats list; - the harness and model picker behaviour; - a new settings page for tools; - native (Tauri) file-path drop handling; - the iOS app; - pairing or attestation (AGENTS.md). ## Findings that drive the design - The two empty "Custom tools" boxes come from the crew and coworkers namespaces. Both contribute `modules: []` (`extensions/crew/src/desktop/index.tsx:11`, `extensions/coworkers/src/desktop/index.tsx:11`). `ConversationModules` renders a fieldset regardless (`CustomizationModules.tsx:70-74`). - The Permissions card renders whenever `permissionState` is set (`ConversationView.tsx:172`). Codex returns `{ kind: 'unsupported' }` (`application-controller.ts:41-44, 272-274`). - The focus ring is `.composer:focus-within` (`application.css:121`). The grip comes from `resize: vertical` (`application.css:119`). - The effort chip is hard-wired disabled (`ComposerAgentControls.tsx:97`). - "Add image" is a text button that opens a hidden input (`ConversationView.tsx:199-210`). - Tauri's native drag-drop handler is on by default, and the window has no `dragDropEnabled` key (`tauri.conf.json:14`). `main.rs:137` builds the window from that config. - Tests depend on hidden header parts: `journey.browser.test.mjs:238` waits for the heading "Your conversation", and `module-actions.browser.test.mjs:85` reads `.scope-label`. The effort chip is asserted at `agent-routing.test.mjs:146-147`. ## Selected design: "Show only what can act" The design began as proposal C (Grok). It adds grafts from A (Opus) and B (Sol). See [research/decision.md](research/decision.md) for the three proposals, the scores and the reasons for each choice. ```text Before (empty Codex chat) After ┌───────────────────────────────┐ ┌───────────────────────────────┐ │ Your conversation │ │ │ │ GPT-6.2 Sol │ │ │ │───────────────────────────────│ │ │ │ ┌ Permissions ──────────────┐ │ │ ╭─────────────────────────╮ │ │ │ does not report… [Refresh]│ │ │ │ Write to Codex…▍ │ │ │ └───────────────────────────┘ │ │ │ │ │ │ Send a message to begin. │ │ │ + Codex ⌄ GPT-6.2 ⌄ ↑ │ │ │ ┌ Custom tools ─────────────┐ │ │ ╰─────────────────────────╯ │ │ └───────────────────────────┘ │ │ │ │ ┌ Custom tools ─────────────┐ │ │ │ │ └───────────────────────────┘ │ │ │ │ ╔═══════════════════════════╗ │ ring │ │ │ ║ Write to Codex… ⟋ ║ │ grip │ │ │ ║ [Add image] ║ │ │ │ │ ║ Codex⌄ GPT⌄ Default⌄ Send ║ │ │ │ │ ║ Local Codex · Approvals… ║ │ │ │ │ ╚═══════════════════════════╝ │ │ │ │ ● Conversation connected Local Codex host │ ● Conversation connected Local Codex · Approvals required for changes │ └───────────────────────────────┘ └───────────────────────────────┘ ``` Once the conversation has content, the transcript scrolls and the same composer sits at the bottom. A pending image is a compact chip inside the composer. The table shows where each removed element goes: | Element | Destination | |---|---| | Header (h1, agent label, scope) | Kept in the DOM but visually hidden. The model chip already shows the agent. | | Permissions card | Rendered only when the provider supports permissions. Its region, labels and buttons are unchanged ([02](02-permissions-and-tools.md)). | | "Send a message to begin." | Removed. The placeholder invites input. | | Custom tools | Empty sets render nothing. Non-empty sets move to the Extensions view. Load and failure notices stay in the column ([02](02-permissions-and-tools.md)). | | Add image | Replaced by a "+" icon button and drag and drop on the panel ([03](03-image-drop.md)). | | Effort chip | Removed. | | Composer disclosure | Moved to the shell footer's right side on the Chats view. | | Ring and grip | Removed. The textarea auto-grows ([01](01-composer-chrome.md)). | ## Review coverage | Stage | Result | |---|---| | Proposals | All three seats completed (`research/proposals/pass-1`). | | Refinement | Recorded in `research/refinement/`. The reviewed packet's SHA-256 is recorded there. | ## Risks and assumptions - **Assumption:** with `dragDropEnabled: false`, the macOS WKWebView delivers HTML5 `File` objects. If not, the "+" picker still works. The fallback is a native-path drop, which is a separate change. Gate: a manual Finder-to-composer drop in `npm run desktop:dev` ([04](04-execution-handoff.md) WP4). - **Assumption:** nothing in the app listens for `tauri://drag-drop`. Gate: `grep -rn "drag-drop\|onDragDropEvent" apps/desktop` returns nothing. - **Tradeoff (non-blocking):** module actions in Extensions run against the active conversation while it is off screen. The section names that conversation. - **Product choice (non-blocking):** the empty canvas has no greeting line. Proposal A's greeting ("A conversation that stays with you.") can be added later as a single element. ## Document map | File | Purpose | |---|---| | [01-composer-chrome.md](01-composer-chrome.md) | Ring, grip, auto-grow, hidden header, empty-state centring, effort chip, footer disclosure. | | [02-permissions-and-tools.md](02-permissions-and-tools.md) | The permissions gate, and moving custom tools to the Extensions view. | | [03-image-drop.md](03-image-drop.md) | The "+" button, drag and drop on the panel, validation, and the Tauri setting. | | [04-execution-handoff.md](04-execution-handoff.md) | Ordered work packages, commands, and the definition of done. | | [research/](research/) | The brief, the decision record, the three proposals and the refinement record. | ### 01-composer-chrome.md # 01 — Composer and panel chrome ## Goal The conversation panel shows a transcript and one quiet composer.
